name: Training Classes In Veda/Devaram
benefit: - Provision of training classes in Veda, Devaram, and Nalayira Divya Prabantham, which are required for divine worship/Poojas. - Instructing pandits are provided an honorarium of ₹1,000/- per month. - The honorarium is given once every three months. - The honorarium is disbursed upon the pandits furnishing attendance particulars of the students who attended the Veda classes.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an eligible candidate to receive the training. - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must know how to read, write, and speak Tamil fluently. - The applicant must be interested in receiving specialized training classes in Veda, Devaram, and Nalayira Divya Prabantham.
